Are these flagged objects landslide scars?

53 objects flagged by the model, in random order. Each row: true colour before (Aug-Oct 2017) and after (Apr-May 2018) the storm, the same view with the flagged object outlined in yellow, and the NDVI change (red = vegetation lost; black outline = the object). A scar looks like a fresh bare, light patch after the event that was vegetated before. Sentinel-2 has 10 m pixels, so judge only what is clearly visible; use the satellite link for a closer look. Answers save in this browser as you go; press the button to download them as CSV and send the file back.
